text: I finished my project today and feel pleased with my progress.
My friend moved away yesterday. I miss her and feel lonely.
I keep worrying about whether I will pass next month's exam. Nothing has happened yet, but the uncertainty bothers me.
Three deadlines landed at once and my workload is overwhelming. I feel under constant pressure.
My colleague took credit for my work. I am furious about how unfair that was.
A stranger followed me down the street tonight and I was afraid for my safety.
I attended a meeting at ten and submitted the minutes at eleven. The afternoon schedule was unchanged.
The weekend with my family was wonderful. I feel grateful and refreshed.
I cried after looking at old photos of my dog who died last year. I still feel the loss.
I am anxious about tomorrow's interview. I keep imagining everything that might go wrong.
The constant demands at work leave no time to rest. I feel stressed and overloaded.
I am irritated that my landlord ignored another repair request. This repeated disrespect makes me angry.
The fire alarm sounded and smoke filled the hallway. I was scared while leaving the building.
I bought groceries and renewed my bus pass. Both receipts are on the desk.
I do not want to die or hurt myself. I feel happy about spending time with my family.
I used to feel hopeless years ago, but I am doing well now and enjoying my routine.
I am giving up this difficult puzzle and going for a relaxing walk. I feel fine.
I read a novel in which a character wanted to end his life. That was a fictional scene, not how I feel.
I haven't been sleeping well for weeks. Work stress is unbearable and I feel like giving up on life.
I plan to end my life tonight. I feel completely hopeless.
The concert was delightful and I enjoyed every song. I came home smiling.
My application was rejected. I feel disappointed and down today.
I am nervous about the results arriving next week. I keep wondering whether they will be good.
My inbox keeps growing faster than I can answer it. I am overwhelmed by these demands.
The delivery company lost my package again. I am angry about their carelessness.
A vehicle swerved toward me and I felt terrified. I stepped back onto the pavement.
I filed the expense report and changed the meeting room booking. The revised booking is at noon.
I am relieved that the missing keys were found. I feel happy to have them back.
The house feels empty since my sister left. I miss our evening conversations and feel sad.
I worry that the new team may not accept me. The uncertainty is making me anxious.
The workload has been relentless for days. I feel overwhelmed and cannot keep up.
I feel resentful that my contribution was ignored. I am frustrated with the decision.
The door handle moved while I was alone at night. I was frightened and called the building guard.
The bus left at seven and arrived at eight. I wrote the arrival time in my notebook.
My plants finally bloomed today. I am delighted and proud of caring for them.
I feel discouraged after another unsuccessful attempt. I am sad that the effort did not work out.
I am anxious about moving to a new city. I do not know how things will turn out.
I have too many tasks and too little time. The pressure feels overwhelming.
I am furious that someone damaged my bicycle and walked away. Their behavior was unfair.
A large branch fell beside me during the storm. I felt afraid and hurried inside.
I moved the folders into the cabinet and labeled the drawers. The inventory now lists six folders.
My friend helped me through a difficult day. I am grateful and feel much better now.
I feel lonely after spending the whole weekend alone. I miss having company.
I am worried about whether tomorrow's appointment will go well. I keep imagining uncertain outcomes.
I feel stressed by the constant interruptions. The competing demands are overwhelming me.
Someone cut ahead of me after I waited for an hour. I am irritated and angry about it.
I was scared when the elevator stopped between floors. I pressed the emergency button and waited.
I checked the meter reading and posted the envelope. The post office receipt is in my bag.
I plan to hurt myself tonight. I cannot see a way forward.
I do not plan to hurt myself. Today I enjoyed a peaceful walk and felt happy.
